shared.surfBiteReport: The most recent available reports for this stretch of coast are from late July 2026, roughly one to three weeks old rather than this week. Along the Gulf-front beaches from Panama City Beach toward 30A, surf anglers were finding Spanish mackerel, whiting, redfish, and jack crevalle in the wash, with pompano also showing up in good numbers — one captain in the area reported 44 keeper pompano in a single outing. The key, as usual in summer, is locating clean-water pockets free of floating grass, then fishing the first and second troughs early in the morning before beach traffic picks up. Water temperature at the surf line today is 85°F, which is typical for early August and keeps fish active but pushes the better bites to dawn and dusk windows.
